{{Quote|Admiral Ar'alani was in command of the force that ultimately drove them away. That's why she came personally to investigate Car'das and his companions. We wondered if the Republic they spoke of might be allied with the invaders.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo, to Kinman Doriana|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
A '''force''' of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]s of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], establishes that the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] have already [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|fought]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the events of the novel take place.</ref> the force participated in the [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|battle]] against a small [[Yuuzhan Vong reconnaissance force|reconnaissance force]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]], in which the Chiss were victorious.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
